title: Parity and Evenness of a Hanna Power Series: A Complete Proof and Lean 4 Formalization of OEIS A326602
description: A separately developed Lean 4 formalization of the evenness and square-index parity theorem for OEIS A326602, from its defining formal power series. The mathematical proof was previously published in trureturing Issue #25051 (November 1, 2026) and is credited here. No claim of mathematical or formalization priority is made. Generative AI contributed substantially to the proof, Lean code and manuscript. The original author-supplied build report is distinguished from independent verification.
